turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma in Jaipur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Sharma. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am Rajesh from the logistics hub. I have a large shipment here for you valued at fifty thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fifty thousand? I am not expecting anything so expensive. What is this for?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is the electronic equipment you ordered last week. My manager told me to coordinate the timing with you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the air purifier for my daughter. I forgot it was that much.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, the premium model. Will you be home tomorrow between 11 AM and 2 PM?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I might be at the temple. Can you come in the evening instead?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can do that. Will 6 PM work for you?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, 6 PM is fine. But is the address correct in your system?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I have it as House 42, Mansarovar. Is that still correct?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, that is correct. Thank you for calling.
